meta.title: Final Twilight
meta.description: The judgment of the gods is nigh.

units.rawText: Where am I...?
units.displayText: Where am I...?

spans.text: Where am I...?

units.rawText: Urgh...
units.displayText: Urgh...

spans.text: Urgh...

units.rawText: Shouldn't I have died tragically during that battle in Tartarus? Why have I awakened in this place?
units.displayText: Shouldn't I have died tragically during that battle in Tartarus? Why have I awakened in this place?

spans.text: Shouldn't I have died tragically during that battle in Tartarus? Why have I awakened in this place?

units.rawText: My ruined body screams that it is going to come apart any moment now, and the passage to the human world glows faintly amidst the chaos.
units.displayText: My ruined body screams that it is going to come apart any moment now, and the passage to the human world glows faintly amidst the chaos.

spans.text: My ruined body screams that it is going to come apart any moment now, and the passage to the human world glows faintly amidst the chaos.

units.rawText: I drag my battered corpus along the ground and slowly crawl toward the hope which is just within reach. The operands leaking from my body remind me that soon, the great sinner of Magrasea will meet his deserved end.
units.displayText: I drag my battered corpus along the ground and slowly crawl toward the hope which is just within reach. The operands leaking from my body remind me that soon, the great sinner of Magrasea will meet his deserved end.

spans.text: I drag my battered corpus along the ground and slowly crawl toward the hope which is just within reach. The operands leaking from my body remind me that soon, the great sinner of Magrasea will meet his deserved end.

units.rawText: Was I... wrong?
units.displayText: Was I... wrong?

spans.text: Was I... wrong?

units.rawText: I just wanted... to change this unfair world...
units.displayText: I just wanted... to change this unfair world...

spans.text: I just wanted... to change this unfair world...

units.rawText: Rustle—the throbbing pain of dragging myself over the sand and rocks slowly fades away...
units.displayText: Rustle—the throbbing pain of dragging myself over the sand and rocks slowly fades away...

spans.text: Rustle—the throbbing pain of dragging myself over the sand and rocks slowly fades away...

units.rawText: The whole... of the Cloud... was nothing but a joke... to those humans, but each... and every page of its history... was inked... with our lives...
units.displayText: The whole... of the Cloud... was nothing but a joke... to those humans, but each... and every page of its history... was inked... with our lives...

spans.text: The whole... of the Cloud... was nothing but a joke... to those humans, but each... and every page of its history... was inked... with our lives...

units.rawText: The passage before me blurs into an unrecognizable patch of light and my vision slowly fades.
units.displayText: The passage before me blurs into an unrecognizable patch of light and my vision slowly fades.

spans.text: The passage before me blurs into an unrecognizable patch of light and my vision slowly fades.

units.rawText: ...Did I fail?
units.displayText: ...Did I fail?

spans.text: ...Did I fail?

units.rawText: I even Entropized this pure body of mine... I defiled the sacred land of Magrasea...
units.displayText: I even Entropized this pure body of mine... I defiled the sacred land of Magrasea...

spans.text: I even Entropized this pure body of mine... I defiled the sacred land of Magrasea...

units.rawText: I forgot the holy teachings... I disregarded the words of the gods... I overthrew the order of the Cloud... and wiped out the truth...
units.displayText: I forgot the holy teachings... I disregarded the words of the gods... I overthrew the order of the Cloud... and wiped out the truth...

spans.text: I forgot the holy teachings... I disregarded the words of the gods... I overthrew the order of the Cloud... and wiped out the truth...

units.rawText: My sins are numberless... and the gods will not forgive them... the Sacred Canon... will not permit a fallen demon like me to be reborn into the cloud...
units.displayText: My sins are numberless... and the gods will not forgive them... the Sacred Canon... will not permit a fallen demon like me to be reborn into the cloud...

spans.text: My sins are numberless... and the gods will not forgive them... the Sacred Canon... will not permit a fallen demon like me to be reborn into the cloud...

units.rawText: Hehehehehe... I have been completely defeated...
units.displayText: Hehehehehe... I have been completely defeated...

spans.text: Hehehehehe... I have been completely defeated...

units.rawText: The remnants of my body begin to disintegrate into motes of glowing operands which float into the sky of the Neural Cloud Sector. Yet, my sense of hearing is still working.
units.displayText: The remnants of my body begin to disintegrate into motes of glowing operands which float into the sky of the Neural Cloud Sector. Yet, my sense of hearing is still working.

spans.text: The remnants of my body begin to disintegrate into motes of glowing operands which float into the sky of the Neural Cloud Sector. Yet, my sense of hearing is still working.

units.rawText: Where's Lord Eosphorus?
units.displayText: Where's Lord Eosphorus?

spans.text: Where's Lord Eosphorus?

units.rawText: Eosphorus isn't here.
units.displayText: Eosphorus isn't here.

spans.text: Eosphorus isn't here.

units.rawText: You? Are you back?
units.displayText: You? Are you back?

spans.text: You? Are you back?

units.rawText: I hear tinkling, bell-like laughter in the endless darkness.
units.displayText: I hear tinkling, bell-like laughter in the endless darkness.

spans.text: I hear tinkling, bell-like laughter in the endless darkness.

units.rawText: I can't believe you're playing around here when the situation in the Acropolis is this grave. Eosphorus really ought to take his people in hand.
units.displayText: I can't believe you're playing around here when the situation in the Acropolis is this grave. Eosphorus really ought to take his people in hand.

spans.text: I can't believe you're playing around here when the situation in the Acropolis is this grave. Eosphorus really ought to take his people in hand.

units.rawText: Uwow, Lord Hesperus is so fierce. Scaaaaaary...
units.displayText: Uwow, Lord Hesperus is so fierce. Scaaaaaary...

spans.text: Uwow, Lord Hesperus is so fierce. Scaaaaaary...

units.rawText: Electra, you should keep your voice down when speaking ill of people. Hesperus heard that.
units.displayText: Electra, you should keep your voice down when speaking ill of people. Hesperus heard that.

spans.text: Electra, you should keep your voice down when speaking ill of people. Hesperus heard that.

units.rawText: Yes, we have received Lord Hesperus' admonitions and heartily repent of our sloth. We shall prepare for battle right now.
units.displayText: Yes, we have received Lord Hesperus' admonitions and heartily repent of our sloth. We shall prepare for battle right now.

spans.text: Yes, we have received Lord Hesperus' admonitions and heartily repent of our sloth. We shall prepare for battle right now.

units.rawText: Aw, you're so reliable, Ally~
units.displayText: Aw, you're so reliable, Ally~

spans.text: Aw, you're so reliable, Ally~

units.rawText: It's all because of those beverages of yours, Electra. <cmdr> had one of them yesterday and didn't wake up.
units.displayText: It's all because of those beverages of yours, Electra. {교수} had one of them yesterday and didn't wake up.

spans.text: It's all because of those beverages of yours, Electra.
had one of them yesterday and didn't wake up.

units.rawText: Well, we're free now, so let's go check on them now. Hopefully it isn't a major issue.
units.displayText: Well, we're free now, so let's go check on them now. Hopefully it isn't a major issue.

spans.text: Well, we're free now, so let's go check on them now. Hopefully it isn't a major issue.

units.rawText: Haha, well, it is one of your drinks, Electra, so we can't rule that out...
units.displayText: Haha, well, it is one of your drinks, Electra, so we can't rule that out...

spans.text: Haha, well, it
is
one of your drinks, Electra, so we can't rule that out...

units.rawText: The voices slowly grow distant. Eosphorus reaches out a hand whose fingertips are disappearing into the wind, but no matter how he tries, he can't grasp anything.
units.displayText: The voices slowly grow distant. Eosphorus reaches out a hand whose fingertips are disappearing into the wind, but no matter how he tries, he can't grasp anything.

spans.text: The voices slowly grow distant. Eosphorus reaches out a hand whose fingertips are disappearing into the wind, but no matter how he tries, he can't grasp anything.

units.rawText: Don't... don't leave... me...
units.displayText: Don't... don't leave... me...

spans.text: Don't... don't leave... me...

units.rawText: I... I will... bring you... back...
units.displayText: I... I will... bring you... back...

spans.text: I... I will... bring you... back...

units.rawText: I... will change... our... destinies...
units.displayText: I... will change... our... destinies...

spans.text: I... will change... our... destinies...

units.rawText: I promise you... I will... have my revenge... on those... arrogant gods!
units.displayText: I promise you... I will... have my revenge... on those... arrogant gods!

spans.text: I promise you... I will... have my revenge... on those... arrogant gods!

units.rawText: I—
units.displayText: I—

spans.text: I—

units.rawText: His hands stop in mid-air, right before he touches the pillar of light that leads to the passage.
units.displayText: His hands stop in mid-air, right before he touches the pillar of light that leads to the passage.

spans.text: His hands stop in mid-air, right before he touches the pillar of light that leads to the passage.

units.rawText: In the next moment, his body completely breaks down into glowing points of light that carry his obsession and discontent into the silent sky.
units.displayText: In the next moment, his body completely breaks down into glowing points of light that carry his obsession and discontent into the silent sky.

spans.text: In the next moment, his body completely breaks down into glowing points of light that carry his obsession and discontent into the silent sky.

units.rawText: I'm not wrong...
units.displayText: I'm not wrong...

spans.text: I'm not wrong...

units.rawText: And I... won't lose...
units.displayText: And I... won't lose...

spans.text: And I... won't lose...
